Random Number Generator

Generate truly random numbers in any range — set min, max and count, allow or forbid duplicates, sort the results and copy them.

📖 How to use

  1. Set the minimum and maximum.
  2. Choose how many numbers to draw.
  3. Toggle unique numbers and sorting if needed.
  4. Click Generate, then copy the results.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Can I get numbers without duplicates?

Yes — enable “unique numbers” and duplicates are excluded (count must fit in the range).

What ranges are supported?

Any range from -1,000,000,000 to 1,000,000,000, up to 1,000 numbers per draw.

Is it cryptographically secure?

It uses Math.random(), which is fine for games and drawings but not for cryptography.

Can I copy the results?

One tap copies all results to your clipboard.
